# BUILDER_PROVENANCE — agent-browser

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Builder version | @hiai-gg/agent-plugin-builder **0.0.6** |
| Builder command | `bunx @hiai-gg/agent-plugin-builder create --config plugin.yml --output plugins/agent-browser` |
| Config file | `plugin.yml` (declarative source of truth) |
| Skill source files | `skills-src/agent-browser/*.md` (bodies via `body-file`) |

## Files generated by Builder

- `plugin.json` — full manifest (name, version 0.0.1, author, homepage,
  repository, license, keywords)
- `skills/browse-web/SKILL.md`
- `skills/test-web-flow/SKILL.md`
- `skills/debug-web-ui/SKILL.md`
- `README.md` (scaffold)

No `mcp.json` — this plugin is intentionally skills-only (CLI + Skills).

## Builder issues encountered

1. `create --config` ignores `--force` on a non-empty output directory (throws
   "Output directory is not empty") — directory must be removed first.
2. Generated README is a minimal scaffold, not a public-ready README.
3. No LICENSE and no CHANGELOG generated.
